notes.title: Version 1.3 is out
notes.content:
Fixed another huge bug, where you would get access to the Floppy if you gained acces to the Chatlogs.

As you may have noticed, this is a difficult game. Feel free to help each other out. I've recently created a subreddit for [url=www.reddit.com/r/afterhoursthegame]After Hours[/url], for discussions and such. I have also posted a map over the puzzles there, to help out those who are stuck.

notes.title: Version 1.2 is out
notes.content:
I've fixed some bugs - thanks for reporting!
[list]
[*] The paths should be correct in Distance now.
[*] You shouldn't be able to click on anything "below" the password request at Swinesweeper.
[*] You can now get more than 7500 points in 1bitboy.
[*] The game doesn't crash now if you click on the final password prompt. That must have been some anti-climax for the player who reported it.
[/list]

I also noticed that Sarah Borokova wasn't doing her job as well as I had hoped. I've added more keywords and more hints for her to give. She is now three times more likely to give you a proper response. 
There might still be some bugs with her sending out double emails. I'm gonna let her run for a while and write down all the bugs I can find.
